content.rendered:
Christopher Nolan’s mythic action epic, in 70mm! After the Trojan War,
Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like
the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way. Starring
Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Lupita Nyong’o
and Charlize Theron.
